backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the GenMitra print platform, defining types (ProductInfo, Order, User, etc.), stable data stores, and lifecycle hooks that seed admin accounts and demo products on upgrade.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts old stable data shapes (e.g., non-optional dpiSettings) to new shapes, enabling safe canister upgrades without data loss.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with associated file paths, component dependencies, test IDs, and confidence levels for TypeScript fixes, router fixes, and image rendering corrections.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source files to short human-readable summaries describing each file's purpose and notable recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom properties for the light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'GenMitra Print Platform', a CSP allowing specific iframe origins, and mounting the app via /src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup that defines all public and admin routes, fixes the router crash by removing the conflicting `id` from the admin layout route, and wraps the app in QueryClient and ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Route guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to the admin login page and shows a loading spinner while the session is being checked.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Admin panel shell with a collapsible sidebar containing navigation links (Dashboard, Products, Templates, Orders, Customers, Settings) and a logout button.
Displays a paginated, sortable customer reviews section with star ratings, reviewer avatars, and an overall rating summary calculated from hardcoded review data.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Renders a two-column accordion-style FAQ section with expand/collapse toggle for each question, using hardcoded FAQ data.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Fetches and displays a grid of featured products (falling back to demo data), supporting optional category filtering and navigating to product detail pages on click.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, contact details, and navigation links for company, support, and legal sections on a dark background.
frontend/src/components/FrameStyleDropdo: A custom dropdown component for selecting a photo frame style, displaying thumbnail images and names for each of the five predefined frame options.
frontend/src/components/HeroBanner.tsx: Renders a full-width hero banner with a background image, headline, subtitle, and a 'Shop Now' CTA button that navigates to the home page.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout component with sticky header, navigation, search bar, cart icon, user menu, mobile menu, and category links. Wraps page content via Outlet and includes a Footer.
frontend/src/components/OffersBanner.tsx: Promotional banner section displaying a 20% off first-order offer with a 'Claim Now' CTA that navigates to the homepage.
frontend/src/components/ProductCategoryG: Displays a grid of five product category cards (Photo Frames, Prints, Magnets, Mugs, Corporate Gifts) with icons and navigates to the filtered product listing on click.
frontend/src/components/ShopFramesBySize: Renders a grid of photo frame size options (4×6 to 27×36 in) with demo images; clicking any frame navigates to the Photo Frames category.
frontend/src/components/TrustFeatures.ts: Static section displaying four trust-building features (star rating, nationwide delivery, satisfaction guarantee, 24/7 support) with icons in a horizontal strip.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminSession.ts: Hook managing admin session state via sessionStorage with hardcoded credential validation, exposing login, logout, and authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Convenience hook combining Internet Identity authentication state with the caller's user profile query, exposing login, logout, and profile data.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state and persisting identity across page reloads using DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including products, templates, cart operations, and orders using tanstack/react-query with an actor-based ICP backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark theme color tokens, and declares reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/demoProducts.ts: Exports a static array of demo ProductInfo objects across categories (photo prints, frames, magnets) used as fallback/placeholder data when the backend is unavailable.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard showing summary stats (orders, earnings, users, products) and a table of the 5 most recent orders, fetched via useGetDashboardSummary and useGetAllOrders hooks.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettingsPa: Admin settings page for managing delivery pincodes, allowing admins to add or remove 6-digit pincodes via form inputs backed by useAddPincode and useRemovePincode mutations.
frontend/src/pages/admin/CustomerManagem: Admin page that lists all users and allows expanding each row to view their order history, fetched lazily on expand.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page for viewing, filtering, and managing all customer orders, with support for status updates, custom image downloads, and production file generation.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductManageme: Admin page for creating, editing, and deleting products, including image compression/upload and size option management via a modal form.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TemplateManagem: Admin page for managing print templates with CRUD operations, image compression, and fields for photo slots and DPI settings.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Cart page component that displays cart items with images, quantities, and total price, and supports removing individual items or clearing the entire cart via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Multi-step checkout page (address → payment) that collects shipping info, lets users pick a payment method, and creates an order via React Query mutations, then navigates to an order confirmation page.
frontend/src/pages/CreateAccountPage.tsx: Account creation form page that collects username and email, then triggers Internet Identity login to register the user.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Interactive photo frame editor page with a canvas-based image editor supporting upload, zoom, rotation, drag, text overlay, frame style/orientation selection, and add-to-cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/ForgotPasswordPage.ts: Forgot password page that accepts an email address, simulates sending reset instructions, and shows a confirmation screen upon submission.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that either renders a category product grid (when a category search param is active) or the full landing page with hero banner, featured products, and FAQ sections.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page supporting two modes: standard user login via Internet Identity and an admin login form with username/password credentials, redirecting appropriately after authentication.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Displays a list of the current user's orders with status icons, colors, and formatted dates, fetched via useGetMyOrders hook. Handles loading, error, and empty states with appropriate UI feedback.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows a post-purchase confirmation screen with the order ID and buttons to track the order or continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Renders detailed information for a single order including a step-by-step status timeline, fetched via useTrackOrder hook. Handles loading, error, and not-found states.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Displays a product detail page with image gallery, customization options (size, frame, media, orientation), pincode delivery check, and a button to navigate to the editor. Falls back to demo product data if backend data is unavailable.
frontend/src/utils/imageHelpers.ts: Utility function that normalizes various image data formats (data URIs, URLs, relative paths, raw base64) into a valid image src string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Inter, Playfair Display), CSS variable-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, font sizes, and keyframe animations for the frontend app.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 69) describing the full-stack online printing/gift platform architecture, known bugs (auth failures, CORS issues, image URL corruption, route conflicts), and a registry of existing and planned features.
